content: REQUIRED DOCUMENTATION FOR SOFTWARE: 1. PRD. 2. UI/UX Specs. 3. System Architecture Document (SAD). 4. API Contracts. 5. DB Schema. 6. Threat Model. 7. DFDs. 8. App Security Policy. 9. CI/CD. 10. Environment Setup. 11. DR Plan. 12. Incident Response. 13. Runbooks. 14. Audit Reports. 15. Dependency Analysis.
